text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm making my way
through the
school halls...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Not really, but... Well, actually, yeah.
Kinda.
choice_data_list: You don't look so good, do you?
You don't look so good, do you?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So I bought this viral tail oil everyone's
been
raving about on Umastagram...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But it makes my tail all sticky when I
run!
And
then all this dirt and grass gets
stuck in it!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I was gonna go out with my friends, but I
can't let
them see me with my tail
looking gross as hell...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, real talk? Tail care is already a
literal pain
in the butt, and this just
made it so much worse.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, this high-key sucks! Especially
on the muddy courses! No matter how
much I wash my
tail after, there's still
mud in it!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But I'm kinda stuck on what to do now. I
spent
good money on this garbage, so I
don't wanna
throw it away...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
choice_data_list: How about only wearing it on days ...
Look for another way to use it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You're so right! I'll just use it when I
don't have to
run!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
All right, problem solved! As a reward,
I'm gonna
go buy myself some snacks!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
What can I even use it for if not as an
oil

treatment, though?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hang on, lemme look it up... "You can
add it to
normal conditioner to boost its
quality."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Talk about a luck break! Looks like I
didn't waste
my money after all. Thanks
for the save! ☆
